context.body: Selected for the reader trail because “Purple, thorns, blows, and a salute” preserves a distinct parallel witness source unit within sentencing.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: Soldiers call together the cohort, use purple and thorns, salute Jesus as king, strike and spit, and then lead him out.
observations.label: Purple, thorns, blows, and a salute: textual observation

observations.body: The passage keeps jesus, soldiers, purple visible within its Crucifixion evidence.
observations.label: Purple, thorns, blows, and a salute: action, promise, or consequence

payload.posture: Read Mark 15:16–20 as its own sentencing and mockery crucifixion setting before carrying its language into another source.
payload.tension: This witness selects its own people, actions, words, and sequence around the Crucifixion without explaining every difference from the other witnesses.
payload.title: Purple, thorns, blows, and a salute
